maddeler.e:
استحضت (form X)
# اِسْتَحَضْتُ (istaḥaḍtu) /is.ta.ħadˤ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَحَاضَ (istaḥāḍa)
# اِسْتَحَضْتَ (istaḥaḍta) /is.ta.ħadˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَحَاضَ (istaḥāḍa)
# اِسْتَحَضْتِ (istaḥaḍti) /is.ta.ħadˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَحَاضَ (istaḥāḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
